study_metadata.title: Cross-Lingual Speech Perception & Prosody Pilot Study
study_metadata.description: This study investigates how focal emphasis and prosody in spoken English are perceived and mapped to Malayalam target sentences.
study_metadata.instructions: Listen to the source English audio carefully. Notice the emphasized word(s) highlighted on screen, and select the Malayalam sentence that best captures the intended emphasis and meaning.

sentences.source_english: I never said she stole my money.

target_options.text: ഞാൻ ഒരിക്കലും അവൾ എന്റെ പണം മോഷ്ടിച്ചുവെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല.
